The map is clear: (2,7) is '@' (me), walkable. The notice board is not drawn as 'o'. So the notice board is a non-blocking-tile object that happens to be co-located with me, OR the "blocks" flag is misleading.

But I can't move. Let me reconsider — maybe the issue is that the game's movement is being blocked by the PLAYER at (3,7) for right, and for other directions... no, up/down/left are open.

Wait. Let me reconsider whether my inputs are even reaching the game. The "facing" changes (facing right, up, down, left) prove inputs ARE reaching. But position never changes. 

This means the game accepts facing changes but rejects movement. That's consistent with being on a blocked tile.

Let me try the one thing I haven't: maybe the notice board can be read to clear it, and reading requires me to be adjacent. Since I'm ON it, maybe I need to interact with it as a self-tile. Let me try pressing KeyE while facing DOWN toward (2,8) — no. 

New idea: maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and I should read it by pressing KeyE, and the game reads the notice when I'm standing on it and press E facing the board's "front". The board's front might be a specific direction. Let me try all 4 facings with KeyE but check if a panel/notice text appears in the observe output.

Actually — let me try a fundamentally different approach. Maybe I can use body_walk_to with a location change or the game has a way to teleport. Or maybe waiting will let the game reset my position. Let me wait a bit and re-observe.
